description: Machine-readable expected outcome for every fixture in this directory; verify-fixtures.mjs fails (non-zero exit) on any mismatch. Every fixture is one receipt, checked against promotion-receipt.schema.json plus the semantic MUSTs the schema alone cannot express: verdict derivation (R10) and semantic_digest recomputation (R12). subject.bundle_digest / subject.selection_manifest_digest / policy_digest / evidence_refs[].digest are syntactically valid placeholders here -- this contract's OWN verifier does not resolve them against a real bundle or a real review-findings record (that cross-record resolution is release-approval/v0's composite fixture's job, per TEST-06/TEST-09). semantic_digest IS recomputed by this verifier on every accept fixture.
